title: Annotatio IV §.XX: presence only SACRAMENTALLY AND SPIRITUALLY — ‘here or there’ corporal claim = false prophets
pass_a_gloss: (2) They add that with and in the bread it is only SACRAMENTALLY AND SPIRITUALLY, not however with the common essential and Accidental properties following — such as is only at the Father’s right in Heaven and to which every faithful ought to attend in mind, consideration of the Material substance of the sacrament suspended: Still more expressly the same, a little after the words Danhauer brought into the midst for Waldenses’ consensus with Lutherans, professing thus; Does not Christ Himself call those who after His corporal departure profess Him corporally present on earth, saying Here or there (in the bread) is Christ, Pseudoprophets, from whom He forewarns His own carefully to beware? (3) To be Christ’s Body in the bread they almost countless times expound by tô to be Christ’s body in the Sacrament SPIRITUALLY.
pass_b_english: (2) With and in the bread the body is only SACRAMENTALLY AND SPIRITUALLY — not with heaven’s essential/accidental properties; the faithful mind attends to what is at the Father’s right, suspending material-substance fixation.

After Danhauer’s ‘consensus’ quotes they add: those who after Christ’s corporal departure say ‘here or there (in the bread) is Christ’ He Himself calls false prophets. (3) ‘Body in the bread’ they almost endlessly gloss as body in the Sacrament SPIRITUALLY.
source_text: (2) Addunt, cum & in pane, esse tantum SACRAMENTALITER ET SPIRITUALITER, non autem communibus proprietatibus, tam essentialibus, quàm Accidentalibus consequentibus, quale tantùm ad dextram patris in Cœlo sit & ad quod omnis fidelis in mente debeat attendere, suspensâ consideratione circa naturam Materialis substantiæ sacramenti: Disertius adhuc idem, paulò post verba, à Danhauero, pro Waldensium cum Lutheranis consensu, in medium adducta, ita profitentes; Annon Christus ipsemet eos qui eum, post abitum illius corporalem, in terris corporaliter præsentem profitentur, dicentes, hic aut illic (in pane) est Christus, vocat Pseudoprophetas, à quibus diligenter cavendis suos præmonet. (3) Esse in pane Corpus Christi, tantum non innumeris in locis exponunt per tô esse corpus Christi in Sacramento SPIRITUALITER.
